subject.title: [Feature]: Expose AI model used and usage cost when using openrouter/auto

question: Should provider-reported routed model and billed cost become canonical generic per-turn metadata across sessions, hooks, and status surfaces, or remain a narrower OpenRouter response-footer feature?
rationale: Current main has relevant low-level fields but no settled persistent or user-visible contract, and the choice affects routing proxies and plugin consumers beyond OpenRouter.

options.title: Generic per-turn metadata
options.body: Promote requested model, actual response model, and provider-billed cost through the generic runner/session/hook contract and render those fields in usage surfaces.

options.title: OpenRouter footer only
options.body: Add a provider-specific footer label and exact cost without expanding persisted or plugin-visible metadata.

recommendation.title: Generic per-turn metadata
recommendation.body: Promote requested model, actual response model, and provider-billed cost through the generic runner/session/hook contract and render those fields in usage surfaces.

likelyOwner.reason: This person has the strongest current history across OpenRouter exact-cost handling, the extracted runtime model contract, and prior review of the related issues.
